title: On Disturbing the sleepers in the next room
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：disturb　|　正文 361 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 disturb 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the builder ① disturbed the sleepers in the next room on the same day, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② disturbs the sleepers in the next room before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ disturb the sleepers in the next room at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ disturbed the sleepers in the next room before — a line in the plan for October 1973 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Disturbing the sleepers in the next room on the same day, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ disturb the water for a mile downstream before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Disturb the water for a mile downstream at once and never mention it again.

By 1986 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ disturbs the water for a mile downstream on the same day every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ disturbed the sleepers in the next room again when nobody else would.

⑩ To disturb the sleepers in the next room, my mother said in 1991, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody disturbs the sleepers in the next room before dawn again and somebody must disturb the sleepers in the next room on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 打扰（一般过去式 disturbed the sleepers in the next room：1979 年施工员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 打扰（一般现在 disturbs the sleepers in the next room：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 打扰（不定式 to disturb the sleepers in the next room：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 打扰（过去完成时 had disturbed the sleepers in the next room：1973 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 打扰（动名词 disturbing the sleepers in the next room 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 搅乱（disturb the water for a mile downstream：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去搅乱把下游一英里的水搅浑）
G. v. 搅乱（disturb the water for a mile downstream：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 打扰（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 disturbs the water for a mile downstream，而母亲又一次 disturbed the sleepers in the next room）

answers.why: disturb 意为“打扰”，1979 年施工员当天就打扰惊动隔壁睡着的人，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 disturbed。
disturb 意为“打扰”，自那以后施工员天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 disturbs。
disturb 意为“打扰”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯打扰惊动隔壁睡着的人”，此处为不定式 to disturb the sleepers in the next room。
disturb 意为“打扰”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1986 年之前就有人打扰过，故用过去完成时 had disturbed。
disturb 意为“打扰”，施工员说“打扰惊动隔壁睡着的人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 disturbing the sleepers in the next room 作主语。
disturb 意为“搅乱”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去搅乱把下游一英里的水搅浑”，should ever 之后用原形 disturb the water for a mile downstream。
disturb 意为“搅乱”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻搅乱把下游一英里的水搅浑（disturb the water for a mile downstream at once），以后再也不要提起。
disturb 意为“打扰”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例搅乱把下游一英里的水搅浑，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 disturbs。
disturb 意为“打扰”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就打扰惊动隔壁睡着的人，用一般过去式 disturbed 叙述。
disturb 意为“打扰”，结尾那句是母亲 1991 年的话：要打扰惊动隔壁睡着的人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 disturb 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the builder disturbed the sleepers in the next room on the same day, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder disturbs the sleepers in the next room before dawn whenever the site asks.
Disturbing the sleepers in the next room on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever disturb the water for a mile downstream before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site disturbs the water for a mile downstream on the same day every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother disturbed the sleepers in the next room again, and the site remembered that half.
